newsitem.title: USA: Tyson says has China poultry agreement.
newsitem.headline: Tyson says has China poultry agreement.

text.p: Tyson Foods Inc said Wednesday it has entered into an agreement with the Kuok Group's Kerry Holdings Ltd to study the feasability of building 10 poultry production plants in the People's Republic of China.
Tyson said it expects construction to begin in the first half of 1998.
The company said it is expected each complex will be capable of producing and processing about 500,000 birds per week, and will employ about 2,000 people.
The company said it will supply manangers, and its wholly-owned subsidiary Cobb-Vantress will supply the grandparent stock for the birds.
The company said its products from the facilities will go to domestic markets in China and to the food service industry in the Pacific Rim.
The company said it expects each complex to consist of a joint venture between local partners and the alliance established by itself and Kerry Holdings.
A company spokesman said it does not yet have an expected dollar value for the deal.
